text:
```yaml
name: Publish Fern Docs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: rust-lang/setup-rust@v1.0.0
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Install Fern CLI
        run: cargo install fern-cli

      - name: Generate Fern documentation preview
        run: fern generate --docs --preview
```
